title: Finite locally constant sheaves of modules: finite values iff finite stalks
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme, $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring and $\mathcal G$ a sheaf of $\Lambda_Y$-modules on the small etale site $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For an etale morphism $u:U\to Y$ [def-weil-etale-morphism] write $\mathcal G|_U$ for the restriction of $\mathcal G$ to the localised site $Y_{\Et}/U=U_{\Et}$ ($V\mapsto\mathcal G(V\to U\to Y)$, a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $U_{\Et}$); for a geometric point $\bar y$ of $Y$ [def-weil-geometric-point] write $\mathcal G_{\bar y}$ for the stalk of the underlying abelian sheaf of $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], a $\Lambda$-module by $\lambda\cdot(\text{germ of }s)=\text{germ of }\lambda s$. The following are equivalent: (1) there are an etale covering $\{u_i:U_i\to Y\}_{i\in I}$ (a jointly surjective family of etale morphisms) and finite $\Lambda$-modules $M_i$ (finite as sets) such that $\mathcal G|_{U_i}\cong\underline{M_i}$, the constant sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules with value $M_i$ on $(U_i)_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], for every $i$ (locally constant with finite constant values: the analogue for $\Lambda$-modules of Stacks 03RU, which states 'finite locally constant' for sheaves of sets and of abelian groups only); (2) $\mathcal G$ is finite locally constant [def-constructible-finite-locally-constant] for the coefficient category of $\Lambda$-modules, i.e. locally constant [def-constructible-locally-constant] and finite [def-constructible-finite]: every geometric stalk $\mathcal G_{\bar y}$ is a finite set; (3) $\mathcal G$ is locally constant and of finite type as a sheaf of $\Lambda_Y$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-module-finite-type] (Stacks 03RW (3), $\Lambda$ being Noetherian as a finite ring). Moreover, in (1), for every $i$ and every geometric point $\bar y$ of $Y$ factoring through $U_i$ ($\bar y=u_i\circ\bar u$ for a geometric point $\bar u$ of $U_i$) the stalk $\mathcal G_{\bar y}$ is isomorphic to $M_i$ as a $\Lambda$-module.

proof.text: For an etale cover member U and a constant-value trivialization F.over U ≅ constant M, use AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.overSheafEquivFunctorObjOverIso and CategoryTheory.Equivalence.constantSheafSheafCongrIso to obtain an isomorphism from the pullback to the constant sheaf on U. Compose AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.upperStarCompSheafFiberIso with the stalk of this isomorphism and CategoryTheory.GrothendieckTopology.Point.sheafFiberConstantSheafIso. This gives F_(s followed by U.hom) ≅ M directly in ModuleCat, for every separably closed point s of U. The categorical constructions already preserve scalar multiplication. This proves the moreover clause, even without finite values.

A finite-type generating cover has on each member an epimorphism from a constant finite free module. Lift any separably closed point to a member using the joint surjectivity of the cover and Mathlib exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed. Transport this epimorphism across the local-site equivalence and take its stalk. The equivalence preserves epimorphisms; the stalk functor preserves them because it is left adjoint to the skyscraper functor (Mathlib Point.skyscraperSheafAdjunction). Identify the source stalk with Fin n → Λ by Point.sheafFiberConstantSheafIso. It is finite, including n = 0, and ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective makes the target finite by Finite.of_surjective. A finite module is finitely generated by Module.Finite.of_finite. Finally transport this property to the original stalk using overSheafEquivFunctorObjOverIso and upperStarCompSheafFiberIso. Thus finite type implies IsFiniteSheaf at all separably closed points.

Given finite constant values, each M_i is finitely generated by Module.Finite.of_finite. Apply locallyConstant_finiteValues_isFiniteType, the stated finite-values-to-finite-type lemma. The supplied LocallyConstantDatum gives local constancy. The previous step gives IsFiniteSheaf, so the sheaf is finite locally constant.

Given a finite locally constant sheaf, take its LocallyConstantDatum and restrict the cover index to members with Nonempty underlying space. This is still jointly surjective: a member covering a point is nonempty. Restrict the constant trivializations to these indices. Choose a point x of each remaining member, let Ω be the separable closure of its residue field, and construct Spec Ω → U via Scheme.SpecToEquivOfField and the residue-field inclusion. The sheaf has finitely generated stalk at its composite point on Y by IsFiniteSheaf. The first step transfers finite generation to its constant value. ModuleCat.isFinitelyGenerated_iff and Module.finite_of_finite show that value is finite as a set. This constructs the required finite-value trivialization, including the empty-base case, where the new index type is empty.

Combine the finite-value-to-finite-type implication and the first equivalence. In the reverse direction, local constancy together with finite type gives IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf by the second step, hence finite values by the fourth. Apply the first step to each specified isomorphism to obtain the final universally quantified stalk isomorphism. IsAlgClosed supplies IsSepClosed.

lean.statement: theorem finite_locally_constant_module_values_iff {Y : Scheme.{u}} {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) : let finiteValues : Prop := ∃ d : LocallyConstantDatum F, ∀ i : d.cover.I₀, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧ Nonempty (F.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i) ≅ (constantSheaf (Y.smallEtaleTopology.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M) (finiteValues ↔ IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf F) ∧ (finiteValues ↔ IsLocallyConstantSheaf F ∧ IsFiniteTypeEtaleModuleSheaf F) ∧ ∀ (d : LocallyConstantDatum F) (M : d.cover.I₀ → ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ), (∀ i : d.cover.I₀, Finite (M i) ∧ Nonempty (F.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i) ≅ (constantSheaf (Y.smallEtaleTopology.over (d.cover.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj (M i))) → ∀ (i : d.cover.I₀) (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ d.cover.X i), Nonempty (((pointSmallEtale (s ≫ d.cover.f i)).sheafFiber (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj F ≅ M i)
